newsitem.title: USA: Franklin Electronic, Voice Powered in pact.
newsitem.headline: Franklin Electronic, Voice Powered in pact.

text.p: Franklin Electronic Publishers Inc has agreed to Voice Powered Technology International Inc's voice recognition technology for its electronic products, in exchange for financing, Franklin said Thursday.

Franklin said it has provided debt and equity financing to Voice Powered and the two companies have agreed to work together to exploit Voice Powered's low-power Voice Logic voice recognition technology for a range of electronic products.
Under the arrangement, Franklin will develop and produce a new line of voice-activated organizers to be sold under its Rolodex Electronics trademark.
The two companies announced in February their intention to merge, but later called off the deal. No reason was given.
Franklin is the world's largest publisher of electronic books.
